<details>
The PKGBUILD is sourced and the `source` array is fetched during these commands. The `sha256sums=('SKIP')` is expected and required for VCS sources.

The only function that executes during sourcing is `pkgver()`, which runs `git describe --long --tags --always | sed ...` inside the cloned repository. This is a read-only operation on git metadata — no network requests, no execution of fetched content, and no exfiltration.

The `build()` and `package()` functions are not executed due to `--nobuild --noprepare`, so the `go build` and `install` steps are out of scope for this gate.
</details>
